# Smart-glasses source acquisition — November 25, 2026

Twelve upstream source snapshots were downloaded at exact commits and SHA-256 checked. The lock lists original archive URLs and license files. This catalog is a dated acquisition record, not a second tool router or an activated integration.

See [research and hardware decision](../../docs/research/smart-glasses-2026-11-25.md). Full original archives and checkout receipts are in the owner-delivered source kit; large archives are not vendored into the production repository. They can be reacquired from the pinned `archive_url` values and checked against `sha256` before use. Preserve upstream licenses and notices.

`build-validation.json` records the one verified build: the official Even minimal starter. Other sources remain unbuilt; no hardware acceptance, third-party skill activation, paid requests or deployment is claimed.
